node.statement: The four (ES)/(ES-G)-consuming lanes' field regimes are mutually unsatisfiable (u2c: log2 Q >= 255.9113; band 1/4-1/8 low depth: >= 255.99999994; band 1/16: >= 256 exactly — deficit >= 512 bits at the cap, NEVER; dli RES: < 256 strictly by its proved H2/A2) — the round-15 unification was of statement shape, not regime, and is WITHDRAWN. Per lane: u2c's pin IS the global form verbatim (five round-16 witnesses re-excluded independently); crossing is covered at w >= 2^37 (19/19 admissible pairs) and fails the binding deep stratum at w = 2^34 at ALL 19 (requirement log2 p >= 256 = the cap) — round 18's THEOREM DSA proved this failure was detecting a real refutation at tower rows; band (both nodes) cannot cite (ES-G) at rate 1/16 anywhere or the low-depth 22.5% of 1/4-1/8, and the banked q >= 2^209 pin computes the RETIRED per-weight threshold, 47.5 bits short (re-derive under the adopted functional — round-18's ternary form is the transfer candidate); dli RES is UNWIRED (above balance by its own hypothesis; round-15's 'discharges all four consumers' REFUTED for it). |Z_w| closed forms for all 8 admissible p-classes banked, with the delta = 4 bracket top NEVER attained (33% over-credit) and the w = 2^38/2^39 orbit merge (ratios not w-uniform). Mechanism: THEOREM Q makes extension degree free for the count while e divides log2 p — tower rows are the adversary, confirmed by round 18. NOT claimed: the band effective-base question; the syzygy bracket end; the band pin repair.
